title: Best mattress protector on the market!
text: Best mattress protector on the market!. This is a really nice fabric protector. First, it fits my deep pocketed mattress perfectly and is not baggy or loose. Second, it is super soft and makes sleeping easy (with no 'crunching' vinyl noises when turning). Most importantly, it's a great protector. Within a week of my putting on the bed, one of my children spilled juice on my bed. I was able to quickly strip the bed to put everything in the wash and the mattress was just perfect. Washing the protector was easy and putting it back on the bed went flawlessly. Highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: Premium Bamboo Mattress Protector Full - Terry Fabric 180 GSM, Dust Proof Ultra Soft Breathable Waterproof Bed Mattress Pad Cover Fitted 18" Deep Pocket, White - Q Quard
features: PREMIUM BAMBOO TERYY: The Q QUARD SIZE Mattress Protector is made of high-quality Bamboo Terry Cotton (80% bamboo fiber & 20% polyester). It is lightweight, noise-free, soft, breathable, and absorbent to liquids, giving you a clean and healthy sleep.

WATERPROOF TOP: This Mattress Protector has an enhanced TPU waterproof membrane on the back and is constructed of bamboo terry cloth on the surface. It provides complete protection to your mattress. It repels all liquids, including spills, and sweat.

18" DEEP POCKET FIT: Our bamboo mattress protector has 18" deep pockets encircled by 360° elastic. Designed in fitted sheet style, it covers mattresses up to 18 inches, giving you the most comfortable, relaxed sleep. It provides a snug fit and protection for your valuable mattress, extending the life of your mattress. No matter how you sleep, the mattress is comfortable.
AVAILABLE IN DIFFERENT SIZES: The Mattress Protector is available in 6 different sizes, Twin, Twin XL, Full, Queen, King, and California King.

EASY CLEANING ANYTIME: The mattress protector can be machine washed, easy maintenance. The products wash and dry wonderfully more durable than cotton. Simply use cold water and choose a regular cycle with no bleach or fabric softener and no fabric dryer protectors. dried on low heat. 40 Degrees Celsius Machine Wash Washing. (DO NOT USE BLEACH, DO NOT IRON, and DO NOT WRING).
